rv.q: Beyond their dubious humor, these overextended one-acts intend to comment seriously upon women being forced to submit to misguided patriarchal authority.
What writer-director Katie Cappiello has wrought are three stories on serious matters.

cn.t: Katie Cappiello's triptych about women named Mary draws divided reactions, with some finding it uproarious and gut-punching while others question its comedic approach to weighty topics like reproductive freedom and the Catholic Church.
